A 6-step portfolio planning workflow where a researcher seeks help planning
multiple proposal submissions for the year. Tests the system's ability to
provide portfolio-based advice including call matching, prioritization,
overlap avoidance, and realistic success expectations. The conversation
builds user context progressively (5 proposals goal, AI/robotics/HMI areas)
and validates that recommendations consider diversification and success rates.
